name: @morra/recognition
description: Browser-facing finger and voice recognizers, extracted from spikes/s01-fingers.html and spikes/s03-beat.html's proven code (MediaPipe HandLandmarker via a classic worker + dynamic import, vosk-browser grammar-restricted call recognition). Implements @morra/core's FingerRecognizer/CallRecognizer contracts. DOM/Worker/AudioWorklet APIs are allowed here (unlike @morra/core) — this package IS the platform-specific glue.
